# Model comparison (generated by evaluate.py)

|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Rules | 75.5 | 81.8 | 92.5 | **86.2** | 0.865 | - | 0.007 |
| kNN | 77.3 | 81.6 | 86.1 | **83.3** | 0.834 | 92.4% | 0.857 |
| SVM | 78.0 | 83.4 | 89.1 | **85.6** | 0.858 | 99.1% | 1.052 |
| Random Forest | 77.2 | 81.9 | 86.8 | **83.8** | 0.839 | 90.9% | 56.016 |
| MLP | 77.3 | 81.9 | 89.8 | **85.1** | 0.854 | 90.4% | 0.105 |

Learning curve (mean accuracy): 10% data: RF 77.4 / MLP 80.8, 25% data: RF 81.5 / MLP 84.5, 50% data: RF 81.4 / MLP 83.0, 100% data: RF 82.0 / MLP 83.0
